# has used

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasUsed`](gmeow-hasUsed.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasUsed>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Records that an agent has used some entity (a tool, service, or work). The period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasUsed`](gmeow-hasUsed.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat shortcut to record that an agent has used a tool, service, or work, when the bare directed fact (optionally with a period on the statement) is enough.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the usage is itself an occurrent that needs participants, instruments, or outcome — model that as an event — and do not treat it as symmetric (the agent uses the entity, not vice versa).

### How to use

- Assert the directed edge from the [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to the used [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); carry the period with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:hasUsed`](gmeow-hasUsed.md) ex:someTool.
